lore:
Khainite Shadow Coven

When Morathi-Khaine needs to dispose of an enemy host swiftly and precisely, she deploys a Khainite Shadow Coven — specialists in subterfuge and misdirection who blend Cauldron gore-smoke with the umbral arts of her elite agents.

Blood and Shadow

A potent Cauldron of Blood anchors the coven, flanked by fearsome Sisters of Slaughter, roaming Khainite Shadowstalkers, and a Bloodwrack Medusa whose malevolent gaze leaves foes vulnerable to a killing blow.

Spearhead Force

Led by a Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood and a Hag Queen, this Spearhead strikes from smoke and shadow — confusing, bleeding, then finishing their prey.

armyRules.name: SHADOWMASKED
armyRules.description: The umbral arts of the Khainite Shadowstalkers and the gore-smoke of the Cauldron are utilised to mask the movements of the Shadow Coven. Declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY unit that is in combat and did not charge this turn to be the target. Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for combat attacks that target that friendly unit for the rest of the turn.

effects.modifier: -1 hit and wound vs this unit
effects.description: Enemy combat attacks targeting this unit subtract 1 from hit and wound rolls

regimentAbilities.name: BLEED THEM PALE
regimentAbilities.description: These aelves delight in bleeding their enemies slowly, darting away before they are attacked in turn. Declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY unit that is in combat and did not charge this turn to be the target. Effect: The target can move 6" but cannot end that move in combat.

regimentAbilities.name: MURDEROUS STRIKE
regimentAbilities.description: A Shadow Coven attacks without warning, seeking to cripple the enemy with the cruelty of their opening strike. Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly INFANTRY units that charged in the same turn.

effects.description: +1 Rend to melee weapons of friendly INFANTRY that charged this turn

enhancements.name: SHADOW AVATAR
enhancements.description: The shadow of the Avatar of Khaine peels away and attacks the foe, every strike cleaving through both body and soul. Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

effects.description: +1 Rend to general’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn

enhancements.name: BOILING BLOOD
enhancements.description: A torrent of scalding blood is vomited forth by the Avatar of Khaine, reducing even polished sigmarite to molten slag. Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of your general to be the target. Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

effects.description: If roll ≥ Save, halve target Move until start of your next turn

enhancements.name: FRENZIED EXHORTATIONS
enhancements.description: The Slaughter Queen atop the Cauldron of Blood howls a bloody liturgy that empowers nearby cultists. Declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target. Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to ward rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

effects.description: On a 3+, +1 to ward rolls for the rest of the turn

enhancements.name: BLADED IMPACT
enhancements.description: The bladed carriage of a Cauldron of Blood can plough its way through enemy ranks with ease. Declare: If your general charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of them to be the target. Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

effects.description: On a 2+, inflict mortal damage equal to the D3 roll

spearheadComposition: General: 1 Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood

units.name: Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood
units.imageUrl: images/daughters_of_khaine/Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood.png

abilities.name: CONSECRATED REVULSION
abilities.description: The Slaughter Queen’s fanaticism is so intense that her deity provides protection for her followers from the attacks of heathens and weaklings. Declare: Pick a visible friendly INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

effects.description: On a 3+, +1 to save rolls until the start of your next turn

abilities.name: WARD (6+)
abilities.description: This unit has a ward of 6+.

abilities.name: BLOODY INCITEMENT
abilities.description: The Hag Queen drives her followers into a violent rage. Declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Effect: If this unit is in combat, the target’s melee weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) for the rest of the turn. If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target’s melee weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) for the rest of the turn.

effects.description: Target melee weapons gain Crit (Auto-wound) for the rest of the turn (auto if Hag Queen in combat; else on 3+)

abilities.name: WARD (6+)
abilities.description: This unit has a ward of 6+.

abilities.name: EXSANGUINATING GLARE
abilities.description: The Bloodwrack Medusa’s eyes blaze with pure hatred, and her victim's blood explodes violently from their every pore. Declare: If this unit is in combat, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. Otherwise, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target. Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any enemy models were slain by that mortal damage, inflict an additional 1 mortal damage on the target.

effects.description: On a 3+, 1 mortal damage; +1 more if a model was slain

abilities.name: WARD (6+)
abilities.description: This unit has a ward of 6+.

abilities.name: SHADOW LEAP
abilities.description: Shadowstalkers can vanish and reappear at will as they navigate the Umbral Web. Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: WARD (6+)
abilities.description: This unit has a ward of 6+.

abilities.name: DANCE OF DEATH
abilities.description: Sisters of Slaughter delight in frustrating foes with acts of incredible acrobatics and martial skill. Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: WARD (6+)
abilities.description: This unit has a ward of 6+.
